name: Kimbundu (Mbundu)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY / CONTACT NODE (metadata only, not a modelled G2P target). Kimbundu is referenced as a representative West-Central African (Bantu) adstrate on Brazilian Portuguese, standing in for the Kimbundu/Kikongo/Yoruba lexical layer brought by the enslaved population (samba, moleque, caçula, cafuné, quilombo). Glottolog namb1293. It carries no grapheme table. A table needs a cited description of the Kimbundu orthography and the sound value of each letter.
